topic: What a vector database is, for beginners

slides.heading: A vector is a *list* of numbers
body: Text can be turned into a row of numbers.
Those numbers capture what the text is about.

slides.heading: Similar meaning, *nearby* points
body: Picture each sentence as a dot on a map.
Sentences that mean similar things sit close together.

slides.heading: A database keeps the *map*
body: It stores millions of these dots.
Give it a new one and it finds the nearest few.

slides.heading: Where you may already *use* one
body: Chatbots that look up your documents.

slides.headline: Meaning, stored as numbers, becomes searchable.
